tasks.brief: You are the only coder on epic E23 (Environment profile and habitat sensors). Build in this order: domain, application, adapters, api, user interface, and run your tests as you go. If an epic you depend on has no code yet, code against its port protocol and the kernel fakes (docs/SYSTEM.md section 10).
